note: Primitive GFP lakeside use area on a wooded peninsula in the 235-acre Amsden Lake, east of Groton off US 12: one loop of back-in sites, boat ramp and dock, fishing pier, swim beach and year-round vault toilets. No drinking water at the park. Sites 1 and 2 face the main lake across small open clearings; 9-12 sit above a cove behind a fringe of shore trees; the rest are in the woods. Pads are posted at 25 ft, a snug fit for a 23-ft rig. The lake is known for muskie over a flooded gravel pit that drops to 27 ft, and gave up the state record at 40 lb in 1991. --Claude
